payload.approved_effect: Perform exactly one bounded Folding@Home retry diagnostic on Lappy using the already-installed official client and existing BananoMiner identity mapped to vera-banano-receiving-v1. The purpose is only to test whether the assigned work unit/core can progress past the prior DOWNLOAD stall.
execution_bounds: No wallet seed or private key may be read or used.
No software installation or account creation.
No second retry or new workload after this bounded diagnostic.
Observe FAHClient/FAHCore state and logs during the retry.
If FAHCore launches, record that download/core acquisition succeeded and stop the Folding workload promptly; do not intentionally complete a work unit.
Stop after 5 minutes if download/core acquisition has not succeeded.
Stop immediately on unexpected state, credential request, or materially different external effect.
payload.postcondition: Record the observed outcome and return the opportunity to screening/decision as required before any further Folding action.
